mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_federated_identity (provider_id, account_id, issuer, subject, display_name, email, email_verified, avatar_url) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{accountId}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{emailVerified}, #{avatarUrl})
mapper.update:
UPDATE auth_federated_identity
display_name = #{displayName.value}, display_name = NULL, email = #{email.value}, email = NULL, email_verified = #{emailVerified.value}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl.value}, avatar_url = NULL,
WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE auth_federated_identity SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_federated_identity WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0 )
